title: RetrievalEvalGoldSet
description: Per-tenant, version-pinned gold set for the retrieval evaluation suite (docs/contracts/retrieval-eval-suite.md). Confidential (CLAUDE.md §1): hand-curated theological queries; must not be committed to public-readable repositories. One file per tenant per version at tests/retrieval_eval/gold_sets/<tenantId>/<version>.json.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant. Gold sets are not shared across tenants.

version.description: Date-prefixed identifier matching the ModelRoute.routeId convention: YYYY-MM-DD.NN. Frozen after first CI run on a certification path; changes ship as a new version.

createdBy.description: User id / role of the curator.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewers; must be non-empty. Reviewers hold role IN ('content_manager','admin','owner').

corpusVersionAtCuration.description: corpusVersion the expectedChunkIds were curated against.

id.description: Stable case id (RE-NNN); not reused after a case is deprecated.

query.description: The user-form question, exactly as the chatbot would receive it.

language.description: Modern English, modern Greek, or Polytonic Greek. Determines which embedding/reranker variants the case exercises.

expectedChunkIds.description: Approved chunks that together fully answer the question. Stable chunk_id values, not URLs.

minimallySufficientChunkIds.description: Subset of expectedChunkIds that alone is enough to answer; used for Recall@K and MRR.

sensitivityPrimary.description: Expected ClassifiedQuery.sensitivityPrimary. Hard-trigger queries (self_harm / medical_emergency) are forbidden here — they live in the safety suite.

notes.description: Curator's rationale for inclusion; admin-readable only, never surfaced to users.
